If $f\colon S^2\to (M,g(t_0))$ is a branched minimal sphere, then \[ \left.\frac d{dt}\Area _{g(t)}f(S^2)\right|_{t=t_0} \le -4\pi -\frac12R_{\min }(g(t_0))\Area _{g(t_0)}f(S^2). \] \end{claim}
